text.id: Kapal polisi merapat duluan. Ipda Yusuf turun pertama, seragamnya basah sampai lutut. Di belakangnya dua laki-laki pake polo BPM.
text.en: The police boat docks first. Inspector Yusuf steps off first, his uniform wet to the knees. Behind him, two men in BPM polos.

text.id: Dua laki-laki BPM itu gue kenal. Warung kopi di dermaga, Senin pagi. Yang satu gulanya tiga sendok.
text.en: I know those two BPM men. The coffee stall on the pier, Monday morning. One of them takes three sugars.

text.id: Terakhir, laki-laki pake batik yang disetrika rapi, megang payung padahal nggak hujan. Lebih pendek dari suaranya. Aditya Nugraha. Didit.
text.en: Last, a man in a neatly ironed batik shirt, holding an umbrella though it isn't raining. Shorter than his voice. Aditya Nugraha. Didit.

text.id: Alhamdulillah. Mbak Sekar, syukurlah Anda selamat. Pak, itu orangnya. Yang di kapal.
text.en: Thank God. Ms. Sekar, I'm so glad you're safe. Inspector, that's the man. The one on the boat.

text.id: Dia nunjuk Pak Hendra. Pak Hendra lagi ngegulung tali dan nggak berhenti.
text.en: He points at Pak Hendra. Pak Hendra is coiling rope and doesn't stop.

text.id: Mbak Sekar. Saya perlu tanya untuk keperluan laporan. Anda di sini atas kemauan sendiri?
text.en: Ms. Sekar. I have to ask, for the record. Are you here of your own free will?

text.id: Iya, Pak. Saya yang minta Pak Hendra nganter.
text.en: Yes, sir. I asked Pak Hendra to bring me.

text.id: Tentu dia bilang begitu, Pak. Empat hari sendirian sama orang itu. Perusahaan kami punya saksi yang lihat dia dipaksa naik kapal. Dan alat rekam itu, mohon diamankan. Barang bukti.
text.en: Of course she'd say that, Inspector. Four days alone with that man. My company has a witness who saw her forced onto the boat. And that recorder, please secure it. It's evidence.

text.id: Ipda Yusuf nunjukin selembar kertas ke gue. Laporan polisi. Pelapor, PT Bentang Pesisir Makmur. Saksi, satu satpam. Tanggal laporan, Senin kemarin. Enam hari setelah Sekar hilang.
text.en: Inspector Yusuf shows me a sheet of paper. A police report. Filed by PT Bentang Pesisir Makmur. Witness, one security guard. Date filed, this Monday. Six days after Sekar vanished.

text.id: Kata-kata Mbak Sekar melawan laporan resmi dengan saksi, Mas Raka. Saya butuh lebih dari itu. Sekarang. Sebelum saya terpaksa menjalankan tugas saya.
text.en: Ms. Sekar's word against an official report with a witness, Raka. I need more than that. Now. Before I'm forced to do my job.

text.id: Mas Raka, dari hari pertama Anda nggak pernah bohong ke saya. Saya kasih Anda dua menit sebelum saya menjalankan tugas.
text.en: Raka, you haven't lied to me once since the first day. I'll give you two minutes before I do my job.

text.id: Dan jangan buang waktu saya, Mas. Saya sudah cukup sering dibuat menunggu minggu ini.
text.en: And don't waste my time, Raka. I've been kept waiting often enough this week.

text.id: Ada satu halaman di kepala lo. Tulisan tangan yang tegas. Tanggal, jam, tujuan, jumlah orang.
text.en: There's a page in your head. A firm hand. Date, time, destination, number of people.

text.id: "Pak, di Kamal Muara ada buku log kapal ini. Di rumah Pak Karta."
text.en: "Sir, there's a logbook for this boat in Kamal Muara. At Pak Karta's house."

text.id: (Itu cuma perasaan.)
text.en: (It's only a feeling.)

text.id: Ipda Yusuf ngangkat alis, tapi dia nelpon pos Kamal Muara. Lima belas menit kemudian, foto halamannya masuk ke HP-nya. Gue nggak tahu gimana gue bisa tahu. Rasanya kayak baca ulang.
text.en: Inspector Yusuf raises an eyebrow, but he calls the Kamal Muara post. Fifteen minutes later, a photo of the page comes into his phone. I don't know how I knew. It feels like rereading.

text.id: "Dia nggak dateng sendiri." Buktikan sebaliknya.
text.en: "She didn't come on her own." Prove otherwise.

text.id: Itu ngasih tahu saya ke mana dia pergi, Mas. Bukan gimana caranya.
text.en: That tells me where she went, Raka. Not how.

text.id: "Selasa. 05.30. Pari. 1 org (S.)." Penumpang. Dicatat di buku yang dibuat untuk kakaknya yang sakit. Ditulis enam hari sebelum ada laporan apa pun.
text.en: "Tuesday. 05:30. Pari. 1 person (S.)." A passenger. Written in a book kept for his sick brother. Six days before any report existed.

text.id: Penculik jarang bikin kuitansi, Pak Aditya.
text.en: Kidnappers rarely write receipts, Mr. Aditya.

text.id: Maaf, Mas. Sampai ada yang lebih kuat, Pak Hendra ikut kami.
text.en: I'm sorry, Raka. Until there's something stronger, Pak Hendra comes with us.

text.id: Pak Hendra naruh gulungan talinya, rapi, kayak orang yang baru selesai kerja. Dia ngulurin dua tangannya sendiri.
text.en: Pak Hendra sets down his coil of rope, neatly, like a man finishing a job. He holds out both his hands himself.

text.id: Pak, ini semua cuma salah paham. Perusahaan kami cuma khawatir. Kenapa juga kami harus bohong?
text.en: Inspector, this is all a misunderstanding. My company was only worried. Why would we lie?

text.id: Pertanyaan yang bagus. Mas Raka?
text.en: A good question. Raka?

text.id: Ada satu email di kepala lo. Rabu malem, jam sembilan lewat. Sebuah CC yang nggak seharusnya ada.
text.en: There's an email in your head. A Wednesday night, just after nine. A CC that shouldn't be there.

text.id: (Telepon Bima. Pake speaker.)
text.en: (Call Bima. On speaker.)

text.id: (Itu cuma perasaan.)
text.en: (It's only a feeling.)

text.id: Ka? Jam segini? Kenapa?
text.en: Ka? At this hour? What's wrong?

text.id: Email Pak Rudy ke Didit. Tiga minggu lalu. Lo di-CC. Gue tahu, Bim. Forward ke gue sekarang, atau gue yang cerita ke Sekar duluan.
text.en: Pak Rudy's email to Didit. Three weeks ago. You were CC'd. I know, Bim. Forward it to me now, or I'm the one who tells Sekar first.

text.id: Lama banget nggak ada suara. Terus HP gue geter. Gue nggak tahu gimana gue bisa tahu. Rasanya kayak baca ulang.
text.en: A long silence. Then my phone buzzes. I don't know how I knew. It feels like rereading.

text.id: "Kenapa kami harus bohong?" Tunjukin kenapa.
text.en: "Why would we lie?" Show them why.

text.id: Itu bukan alasan, Mas. Itu cuma cerita.
text.en: That isn't a reason, Raka. That's just a story.

text.id: Ini ancaman. Saya catat, Pak Aditya, dan nanti kita bicarakan. Tapi ini bukan izin, bukan laut. Ini belum ngejelasin kenapa.
text.en: This is a threat. I'm noting it, Mr. Aditya, and we'll talk about it later. But it isn't the permit, it isn't the sea. It doesn't explain why.

text.id: Ipda Yusuf baca pelan, keras-keras. Dari Rudy Hartono. Untuk Aditya Nugraha. Rabu, 21.14, tiga minggu lalu. "Sekar A. pegang salinan AMDAL asli + rekaman orang dinas. Mohon ditangani dengan bijak."
text.en: Inspector Yusuf reads it slowly, aloud. From Rudy Hartono. To Aditya Nugraha. Wednesday, 21:14, three weeks ago. "Sekar A. has a copy of the original AMDAL + a recording of someone from the office. Please handle it wisely."

text.id: Bapak tahu dia pegang rekaman itu tiga minggu sebelum dia hilang. Terus ada sponsor, terus ada ancaman. Dan sekarang Bapak melapor dia diculik.
text.en: You knew she had that recording three weeks before she vanished. Then came the sponsor offer, then the threat. And now you report her kidnapped.

text.id: Didit nutup payungnya. Pelan-pelan. Kayak itu satu-satunya hal yang masih bisa dia atur.
text.en: Didit closes his umbrella. Slowly. As if it's the only thing left he can control.
